note.after_visit_summary: Your child has strep throat, confirmed by a positive test. He has a sore throat, fever, and swollen tonsils with white spots. He is allergic to amoxicillin, so he will take Cefilxin 400 mg by mouth twice a day for 10 days. For throat pain and fever, give ibuprofen 200 mg by mouth every 6 to 8 hours as needed with food. He can return to school after taking the antibiotic for at least 12 hours and being fever-free, likely Thursday. Replace his toothbrush after a day or two on the medicine. Go to the emergency room if he starts drooling, cannot swallow saliva, cannot open his mouth fully, or has trouble breathing. Call the clinic if he is not better in two or three days. A school note has been sent to the portal.
